folder.title: Questionnaires, map traces, campaign notes.
folder.copy: An eight-person study of older Shanghai neighborhoods moved from community research into two different interventions: a walking-time map and public information campaigns.
folder.note: The prototype made nearby facilities visible; it did not prove a long-term improvement in quality of life.

components.title: The enclosure had to shrink around the electronics.
components.copy: The sensing decision became a packaging problem: solder the signal path, arrange the ESP32 boards and battery, reserve access points, print a shell, then revise the interior around what did not fit.
components.note: The model is evidence of iterative packaging and internal component organization—not a finished manufactured enclosure.

envelope.title: What happened after the probability matrix?
envelope.copy: The packet keeps the realization and evaluation stages beside the algorithm instead of presenting the fractional result as the finished system.
envelope.note: The percentages come from the original presentation and remain reported results until the underlying output is rerun.
